system_prompt: You write instructions that a person would say to a robot arm sorting toy blocks into containers on a table. Answer with JSON only.

prompts.en/object:
Write 40 different instructions in English that tell the robot to pick up one specific object and put it into a container.
Use the placeholder {obj} for the object phrase and {dest} for the container phrase, each exactly once. Do not use any other braces.
{obj} will be replaced by phrases such as: the red cylinder, the small cube, the blue object.
{dest} will be replaced by phrases such as: the left tray, the round bin, the grey tray.
Vary the verb, the word order and the politeness: short commands, polite requests, casual speech. Each instruction has 3 to 20 words, one sentence, no numbering.
Return {"templates": [...]}.
prompts.en/class:
Write 40 different instructions in English that tell the robot to pick up any one object of a class (the robot may pick any matching object) and put it into a container.
Use the placeholder {obj} for the object phrase and {dest} for the container phrase, each exactly once. Do not use any other braces.
{obj} will be replaced by phrases such as: a red object, a cylinder, a small object.
{dest} will be replaced by phrases such as: the left tray, the round bin, the grey tray.
Vary the verb, the word order and the politeness: short commands, polite requests, casual speech. Each instruction has 3 to 20 words, one sentence, no numbering.
Return {"templates": [...]}.

{obj} will be replaced by phrases such as: khối trụ đỏ, khối lập phương nhỏ, vật màu xanh dương.
{dest} will be replaced by phrases such as: khay bên trái, thùng tròn, khay xám.
Vary the verb, the word order and the politeness: short commands, polite requests, casual speech. Each instruction has 3 to 20 words, one sentence, no numbering.
